test_maliciousAdapterCannotExceedApprove.details: THE key regression test for the delegatecall -> call fix. A malicious adapter must be capped at the allowance it was explicitly approved for; it cannot drain funds beyond that, and it cannot corrupt TriangleArb's owner/locked storage since it runs in its own context.

test_multiHopWithinSingleLeg().details: Multi-hop-within-a-leg: a single leg chains WETH -> USDC -> USDT on ONE adapter, instead of splitting that into two separate legs. Confirms the Hop[] chain inside a leg produces the same result as two 1-hop legs would, and that intermediate tokens never have to round-trip back through TriangleArb between hops.
